attchmntText: Zee Media Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Un-audited Financial Results for the Quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Zee Media Corporation Limited published newspaper advertisements on November 15, 2026, regarding its un-audited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 14, 2026. Consolidated total income was Rs 1017.55 lakhs, with a profit before tax of Rs 349.8 lakhs. Standalone total income was Rs 96.02 lakhs, with a profit before tax of Rs 41.85 lakhs. Basic earnings per share were Rs 0.13 for consolidated figures and Rs 0.13 for standalone figures. INDO-MIM Limited also approved its un-audited financial results for the same period on November 13, 2026. Consolidated net profit after tax was Rs 82.07 lakhs, with basic earnings per share of Rs 0.08. Standalone net profit after tax was Rs 7.35 lakhs, with basic earnings per share of Rs 0.01. Equippp Social Impact Technologies Limited approved its results on November 13, 2026. GE Power India Limited approved its un-audited financial results on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Zee Media Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Rajiv Goel as Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 14, 2026.
voiceSummary: Zee Media Corporation Limited has approved the appointment of Mr. Rajiv Goel, DIN 05161245, as an Additional Director in the category of Non-Executive Independent Director. This appointment is effective from November 14, 2026, until November 13, 2031, for a term of five consecutive years. Mr. Goel is not liable to retire by rotation. The appointment is subject to requisite shareholder approvals. Mr. Goel is a Chartered Accountant with over 31 years of experience in corporate finance and capital markets. He previously served as Senior Vice President at DLF Ltd. from 2007 to 2020. He currently holds independent director positions at Goodluck India Ltd. and Delhi Transco Ltd. The Board meeting commenced at 1530 Hrs and concluded at 1845 Hrs on November 14, 2026. Financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, were submitted separately.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Zee Media Corporation Limited filed a Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding funds raised through convertible warrants aggregating to Rs. 119 crore. The report was reviewed by the Audit Committee and Board of Directors on November 14, 2026. The Monitoring Agency, CARE Ratings Limited, reported no deviation from the objects of the issue. The company utilized Rs. 8.67 crore for payment of current liabilities, including salary for June 2026, and Rs. 21.26 crore for capital expenditure towards content rights acquisition. The agency noted that funds were transferred from the monitoring account to the current account, resulting in comingling. The share price was reported at Rs. 7.20 as of September 30, 2026, below the warrant issue price of Rs. 8.50. The company reported a net loss of Rs. 12.12 crore in Q1 FY27.

attchmntText: Zee Media Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Zee Media Corporation Limited approved the Un-Audited Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board met on November 14, 2026. The company reported a loss after tax of 1,941 lakhs for the quarter and 2,823 lakhs for the half year. Revenue from operations was 13,143 lakhs for the quarter and 26,376 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were negative 0.30 rupees for the quarter and negative 0.44 rupees for the half year. The company issued Foreign Currency Convertible Bonds worth 3,718 lakhs. It also allotted 14,00,00,000 fully convertible warrants and converted 3,00,00,000 warrants into equity shares. The statutory auditors are Ford Rhodes Park & Co. LLP. The results are on a standalone basis.

attchmntText: Zee Media Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a earning release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Earning Release" for the quarter & half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Zee Media Corporation Limited reported financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results. Operating revenue for H1FY27 was 3,723 million, compared to 3,611 million in H1FY26. Like-for-like operating revenue grew 19.9%. Linear TV advertising revenue increased 29.5% to 2,654 million. Digital advertising revenue stood at 888 million. Operating expenditure was 3,515 million. Operating profit, or EBITDA, was 208 million. This represents a 43.58% decline from 369 million in the corresponding period last year. The earning release is available on the company website.
